note: The story beats and their unlock order, measured through the shipped reducer.

beats.title: Ashen Signal
beats.body: The frontier beacons relight after years of silence. Your command seal activates and old war machines answer your name.

beats.title: The Raider Accord
beats.body: Scattered clans rally under a red standard. Every wave you clear denies their pact another foothold.

beats.title: Roots of the Citadel
beats.body: Ancient gardens overrun the old roads. Beneath the vines, imperial vault doors begin to open on their own.

beats.title: Glass and Oathfire
beats.body: The crystal city fractures from within. Echoes of the first dynasty demand tribute in blood, gold, and memory.

beats.title: Storm Court
beats.body: A council of storm captains crowns a false sovereign. Their fleets ride lightning across the abyss horizon.

beats.title: Crownfall Depths
beats.body: Sunken throne-ships awaken below black tide. Every captain you defeat restores one lost imperial oath.

beats.title: Eternal Eclipse
beats.body: Daylight dies over the campaign line. Your banner is now one of the final symbols of lawful command.

beats.title: Abyssal Maw
beats.body: The monsters no longer retreat. They are converging. Something vast stirs in the deep, drawn by your victories.

beats.title: Ascendant Path
beats.body: The boundary between mortal and legend begins to dissolve. Your heroes transform. The cost of power becomes visible.

beats.title: Rebirth Protocol
beats.body: Death no longer closes the ledger. You begin rewriting fate through controlled collapse and rebirth cores. Your first cycle completes.

beats.title: Throne of Kings
beats.body: Wave 150 marks a reign. Empires rise from your legacies. Ancient records now bear your seal across generations.

beats.title: Eternity Engine
beats.body: Wave 200. Your heroes' names become myth. The cycles accelerate. You are no longer led by time; you lead it.

beats.title: Dynasty Engine
beats.body: Your cycles form a war-dynasty. Heroes no longer fight for survival alone, but for succession across eras. Legacy multiplies.

beats.title: Void Covenant
beats.body: Wave 300. The abyss speaks in your voice now. Cults emerge in your wake, seeking the secret of your infinite return.

beats.title: Transcendence
beats.body: Wave 400. You are no longer mortal. Neither are those who follow you. The cosmos itself bends to your campaign.

beats.title: Eternal Recursion
beats.body: Prestige 10+. Your rebirths now create branching timelines. Each cycle feeds the next. You are unstoppable.

beats.title: Singularity Breach
beats.body: Wave 500. Reality fractures under the weight of your victories. The final monsters are echoes of collapsed universes.

beats.title: The Empty Throne
beats.body: At the edge of all things, one throne remains unclaimed. The cults, captains, and dynasts now turn toward you. The choice is yours alone.

beats.title: Infinite Ascension
beats.body: Prestige 25+. You have transcended the limitations of your world. Godhood is no longer a destination—it is a waypoint.
